reviewedSourceFiles.classification: New static discovery reads executable PATH/realpath and package-bound npm/man/dpkg/Homebrew descriptions without spawning. Same-name wrappers cannot borrow unrelated man/package documentation; unknown usage remains visible. Metadata reads use file-version cache and bounded concurrency, not entry/count truncation.
Observation-only query projection returns all matches; legacy query/version-bound cursors still validate. No scheduler or execution authority transition.

Trusted catalog parser removes character/count/aggregate metadata caps and adds scenario/provenance/variant usage fields; syntactic shape and unknown-field rejection remain. Catalog hashes now cover complete usage metadata.

stdin repeat identity includes path plus measured bytes/hash/environment. Unmeasured pure requests defer only stdin repeat checks to runtime; no-input original repeat bound remains. Independent bounded behavior tests cover this new data domain.

Read-only automatic PATH installation observations carry catalog/time/path; older receipts cannot overwrite newer installation facts. Authentication remains unknown unless the exact registered no-stdin invocation established a failure; no grants.
viewTasks decodes/clones one room snapshot in one store read for history projection; no transaction, mutation, scheduler or cross-room read added.
spawn receives an optional already-prepared stdin fd, otherwise original ignore/EOF. Process lifecycle, shell=false, cancellation/journal callbacks and effect classification remain.

Optional workspace stdin action/host plan fields are shape-validated; approval input path/hash/bytes must correspond to the action. Discovery count caps removed; only exact persisted successful host metadata receipts are excluded from conversational/result size accounting. Original attempt/session/approval/lease/stop guards remain.

Workspace input is snapshotted before approval and spawn; host commandDigest includes input plan; stdin repeat guard runs after measuring bytes/environment. Settled redacted invocation is captured for sandbox and host. Exact approval digest anchor, persisted journal and launch/effect boundaries remain; metadata-only results bypass former aggregate truncation.

New runtime preparation verifies workspace-relative file boundary/private exclusions and inode, snapshots raw bytes to an unlinked read-only fd, and hashes actual bytes; fd is closed at settlement. This strengthens actual stdin input binding outside old opaque Host graph; runtime probes and source faults cover it.

Mutable-work requests include complete automatic catalog and CAR experience observations. Deadline failure WORK_TIMEOUT is non-transient, network failure remains separately transient; runner maps only actual task hardDeadline expiry to WINDOW_EXPIRED. Fixed-check source metadata now includes host-captured invocation through evidence.ts, not live catalog/experience authority.
Public read-only tool interface descriptions expose stdin and complete matching metadata. Selected-entry identity remains metadata-bound; no command is launched by projection.

Current room history is read once via trusted viewTasks; observations remain gated by localTools and role/epoch/goal. WORK_FAILED carries explicit WINDOW_EXPIRED only when current active task window actually expired, suppressing transient; immutable submit/claim/invoke paths retain ownership and execution fences.
WINDOW_EXPIRED explicitly cannot consume a transient retry. Existing request, ordinary, check and retry accounting bounds remain for their old model event domain.

Actual invocation is projected only from validated already-redacted host receipt data. Private cliSnapshot freezes action/requestHash/raw invocation/validationInputsChanged and is compared on fixed-check reuse; missing legacy CLI snapshots reject rather than silently bind new identity. Existing stdout/stderr and resource snapshots remain. New input identity is tested by direct model/BDD/source controls, not claimed as new TLC states.

Active hardDeadline failures/replies enter waitingHuman; skip on a non-window required question records only that scope then asks newWindow, while explicit window skip/stop ends. Existing old finite graphs stay before hardDeadline; stop and terminal recovery retain their original order.

Real taskMachine routing prioritizes active expiry to waitingHuman for SUPERVISE/WORK_FAILED/RECOVER/EXHAUSTED/EXECUTION_NOT_STARTED and old-gate responses. Existing required gates and physical custody are not resolved by the timeout. New transitions have dedicated actual XState gates; old finite domains are not broadened.

Active hardDeadline rejects with WINDOW_EXPIRED before shorter work deadline; work-only expiry retains WORK_EXPIRED. CONTINUE cannot bypass an unanswered host/required gate. Existing short-clock formal inputs remain within the task window.

Active CONTINUE(newWindowMs) reuses decideHumanGate and preserves epoch; terminal continue preserves old epoch increment. Expired work/recovery/exhaustion request newWindow. Existing outcome/stop/result-consumption/publication transactions remain atomic; no new I/O in actions.

Intentional promise change: 15m automatic expiry ending partial/failed becomes 3h default plus durable WINDOW_EXPIRED/newWindow gate. Cleanup ownership is adopted before waiting; pending map/interpretation/help states retire safely while saved results keep identity; six phase resume uses existing handoff/check. Repair deadline remains separately bounded. Grant revocation is not renewed by newWindow.

New pure CAR projection includes versioned workspace/OCR recipes and matched current-room historical capabilities. It stores no global private corpus; historical metadata never proves new resource acquisition, grants execution, or crosses room boundaries.

Settled capability observations and verified resource methods remain read-only; complete current metadata is referenced by immutable versions rather than copied/truncated. Existing trusted acquisition/config/resource-scope checks still determine resource methods.

Fixed validation argv contract now explicitly rejects extra stdin, preserving the exact original validation command; old Verification domain submits no stdin. New rejection has a direct real-model/public-entry test.

No-config catalog is built automatically from static installed metadata; explicit catalog remains supported. Background atomic generations/error retention remain; entry identity covers full variant provenance. No help/login/host execution during discovery.
WORK_FAILED gains optional code string only; old event literals and durable schema remain readable. Pure policy owns semantics, external strings do not create permissions.
Read-only API adds explicit window failure code and host stdin path/hash/bytes. No new trusted command interface.

Projects newWindow actions/failure and exact stdin approval information; expired cancelled resource waits retain current-session links to conflicting owners. Forwards observation getter only; normal trusted approval/engine APIs remain the mutation boundary.

Unrelated controlled process fixture explicitly uses cliCatalog:[] to hold automatic discovery outside its slice; automatic catalog tests opt in. Existing model protocol/assertions and real bridge paths remain intact.

sliceCorrespondence: Original saved result consumption/unique resume and failure retry graphs use short clocks and no active expiry gate. Existing result markers and retryOf transactions are unchanged; active newWindow preserves already-saved results and requires separate scenarios.
